{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-t15y","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-1hbf: Rust EDHOC test vectors are self-referential","description":"## Issue

`rust/lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs:2067-2190`: The test vectors for TH_4, prk_out, prk_exporter, OSCORE master_secret, and OSCORE master_salt were updated to match the Rust implementation output. These expected values were computed from the same code they are testing, making them self-referential oracles.

## Risk

If the implementation is wrong (e.g., wrong CRED_R encoding, wrong KDF order), tests will pass because expected values were computed from the same wrong implementation.

## Fix

Derive test vectors from an independent oracle:
- Python reference implementation (once Python is also fixed to match spec)
- External cryptographic tool (openssl KDF, pyca/cryptography)
- A second independent implementation
- Pre-computed and committed as hex literals with source annotation
